_meta.goal: Strength, longevity, fat loss (VAT reduction). Attia 4 Horsemen framework. Injury history: ACL 2019, left foot Jones fracture 2017, bilateral shoulder tears 1994/2016.
_meta.notes: Add exercises to any pattern pool to increase variety. The app cycles through each pool in order, resetting when exhausted. Remove an exercise to retire it.

exercises.name: Movement Prep — Standard
exercises.desc: Hip flexor stretch 60s each side, thoracic spine rotations on foam roller, shoulder CARs — full slow circles through complete range. Non-negotiable given shoulder history.

exercises.name: Movement Prep — Short
exercises.desc: Hip circles, leg swings forward and lateral, arm circles, shoulder rolls. Use for Day 3 metabolic sessions where the warmup is shorter.

exercises.name: Trap Bar Deadlift
exercises.desc: Stand center of trap bar. Hinge at hips, neutral spine, chest up. Drive through the floor — push the floor away. Lock out hips at top. Preferred over conventional: better for 6'3" frame, protects left foot under heavy load.
exercises.tip: Week 1: 240 · Week 2: 250 · Week 3: 260 · Week 4: 270. Reset if form breaks.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.desc: Barbell from rack or floor. Hinge to just below the knee — feel the hamstring stretch. Drive hips forward to lockout. Keep shins nearly vertical. Greater hamstring emphasis than trap bar.
exercises.tip: Block 2 primary. Lower weight expected vs. trap bar — hamstring stretch is the goal, not max load.

exercises.name: Single-Leg RDL
exercises.desc: Stand on one leg. Hinge forward with flat back, free leg extends behind. Touch DB to floor or shin. Addresses left/right DEXA asymmetry. Start bodyweight — balance is the challenge.
exercises.tip: Left leg is the weaker side per DEXA. Extra focus on balance here.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.desc: KB at chest, elbows inside knees at bottom. Sit back and down — not just down. Drive knees out. Full depth as mobility allows. Monitors ACL tracking.

exercises.name: Heel-Elevated Goblet Squat
exercises.desc: 1–2 inch plates under heels. Same goblet position but heel elevation dramatically improves depth and quad emphasis. Great plateau-breaker when mobility limits standard goblet depth.
exercises.tip: Heels elevated = more quad recruitment. Use when gym has no safety bar.

exercises.name: Safety Bar Squat
exercises.desc: Safety bar sits on upper traps in a more comfortable position than standard bar. More upright torso than back squat, significantly easier on shoulders. Great for heavy loading without shoulder compromise.
exercises.tip: If gym has a safety bar, use this over standard back squat given shoulder history.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported DB Row
exercises.muscles: Mid traps, Rhomboids, Lats / Rear delts, Biceps
exercises.desc: Incline bench ~45°. Chest on pad, feet on floor. Row both DBs to hips — lead with elbows. Pause 1s at top. Chest support eliminates lower back involvement and is safe for both shoulder repairs.

exercises.name: Barbell Row (Pendlay)
exercises.muscles: Lats, Mid traps, Rhomboids / Erectors, Biceps
exercises.desc: Bar on floor each rep. Hinge to near-horizontal back. Pull bar to lower chest — elbows close. Reset to floor. Full stop eliminates momentum. More total back development than chest-supported row.
exercises.tip: Monitor lower back — if fatigue affects form, drop to chest-supported that session.

exercises.name: TRX Row
exercises.muscles: Mid traps, Rhomboids, Rear delts / Biceps
exercises.desc: Lean back with straight body. Pull chest to hands — elbows back, shoulder blades squeeze together. More horizontal = harder. No equipment needed beyond TRX. Good metabolic day finisher.

exercises.name: Eccentric Pull-Up
exercises.muscles: Lats, Teres major / Biceps, Rear delts
exercises.desc: Stand on box, neutral grip. Jump or step to top position — chin over bar. Lower under control for 4–6 seconds to dead hang. You are 20–30% stronger eccentrically. This is the fastest path to a full pull-up.
exercises.tip: Goal: first bodyweight pull-up. Grip strength is a top longevity predictor (Lancet 2015).

exercises.name: Cable Pulldown (Neutral Grip)
exercises.muscles: Lats, Teres major / Biceps, Rear delts
exercises.desc: Neutral grip V-bar or rope. Pull to upper chest — lead elbows down and back. Full stretch at the top. Neutral grip is safer for shoulder repairs than wide overhand.
exercises.tip: Alternate with eccentric pull-ups — use pulldown when a pull-up bar isn't available.

exercises.name: Weighted Pull-Up
exercises.muscles: Lats, Teres major / Biceps, Rear delts
exercises.desc: Full bodyweight pull-up with added load via belt. Neutral grip preferred for shoulder health. Block 2+ progression once bodyweight pull-up is achieved. Complete range of motion — dead hang to chin over bar.
exercises.tip: Only use when you can do 5+ clean bodyweight reps. Otherwise stay on eccentric protocol.

exercises.name: Landmine Press
exercises.muscles: Anterior delt, Upper chest / Triceps, Serratus
exercises.desc: Anchor barbell in corner or landmine attachment. Press from shoulder height at ~45°. Neutral grip arc — the key shoulder-safe pressing variation. Takes shoulder out of the impingement zone that barbell pressing creates. Split stance for stability.

exercises.name: Incline DB Press
exercises.desc: Bench at 30–45°. Feet flat on floor. Elbows at ~45° from torso — not 90°. Full range of motion. Stop immediately if shoulder impingement — reduce range or angle.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Z-Press
exercises.desc: Sit on floor, legs straight out. Press DBs overhead from shoulder height. Floor position eliminates any leg drive, forces true shoulder strength. Neutral or slight pronation grip — don't fully lock out if impingement.
exercises.tip: Block 2 variation. Lower weight than landmine is expected and correct.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.desc: Rear foot elevated on bench, front foot 2–3 feet forward. Lower until front thigh parallel. Front shin stays vertical. Directly addresses left/right leg asymmetry from DEXA. ACL-safe.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge
exercises.desc: Step back — not forward. Rear knee drops to just above floor. Front shin stays vertical, knee tracks over toe. ACL-safer than forward lunge and easier on the Jones fracture side.

exercises.name: Step-Up
exercises.desc: Box or bench ~16". Step up, drive through heel of top foot — don't push off back foot. Stand fully at top. Step down controlled. ACL and foot-friendly.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge
exercises.desc: Step forward into lunge, drive through front heel to standing, step through into next lunge. Adds balance and coordination demand over static lunge. Keep torso upright. Monitor left foot on impact — reduce load if any discomfort.

exercises.name: Farmer Carry
exercises.desc: Two KBs, stand tall, walk controlled line. Head up, shoulders packed. Strong grip throughout. Conservative load given left foot history — drop if any foot discomfort.

exercises.name: Suitcase Carry
exercises.desc: Single KB in one hand, walk tall. Resist the urge to lean away from the load. Unilateral load drives lateral core anti-flexion. Harder than farmer carry for core demand.
exercises.tip: Builds lateral spine stiffness that protects against falls — underrated longevity exercise.

exercises.name: Half-Kneeling Pallof Press
exercises.muscles: Obliques, Deep core / Glutes, Hip stabilizers
exercises.desc: Half-kneeling perpendicular to cable stack, inside knee down. Cable at chest height. Press straight out from chest and hold 2 seconds — resist rotation the entire time. The goal is NOT to rotate. Pull back in.
exercises.tip: Anti-rotation training protects the lumbar spine and improves transfer to deadlift and carry.

exercises.name: Pallof Press (Standing)
exercises.desc: Stand perpendicular to cable, feet shoulder width. Press cable straight out from chest, hold 2 seconds, return. Standing version increases demand vs. half-kneeling. The challenge is resisting rotation throughout.

exercises.name: Face Pull / Band Pull-Apart Superset
exercises.muscles: Rear delts, External rotators / Mid traps, Rhomboids
exercises.desc: Face pull: cable at face height, rope attachment, pull to forehead with external rotation — show your biceps at end. Immediately follow with band pull-apart: arms straight, pull band to chest width. Never skip this.
exercises.tip: Protects both shoulder repairs over the long term. Do this every Day 2 regardless of what else changes.

exercises.name: Half-Kneeling Face Pull
exercises.muscles: Rear delts, External rotators / Mid traps
exercises.desc: Half-kneeling facing cable. Pull rope to face with external rotation — elbows high, show your biceps at end position. Half-kneeling increases core and glute demand vs. standing.

exercises.name: KB Swing
exercises.desc: Hip hinge — not a squat. Drive hips forward explosively to float the bell to chest height. Hike it back between legs, load the hips. Speed and hip drive matter more than load. Stand on both feet — protects left foot.

exercises.name: One-Arm KB Clean
exercises.desc: KB between feet, hinge. Drive hips explosively — punch the KB up and catch in rack position (KB resting on forearm, elbow tucked). Power comes from hip drive, not your arm.
exercises.tip: From your Evernote KB Conditioner archive.

exercises.name: Double-Arm KB Swing
exercises.desc: Both hands on KB. Same hip-hinge drive as single-arm swing — double handle gives more control and allows a heavier bell. Float to chest height, load the hips on the backswing.

exercises.name: Sled Push
exercises.desc: Lean into sled ~45°, drive through the floor with short powerful steps. No eccentric load — best recovery cost-benefit ratio of any exercise. Excellent for VAT (visceral fat) reduction.

exercises.name: Rowing Ergometer — Steady
exercises.desc: Legs to hips to arms on the drive. Arms to hips to legs on recovery. 22–26 strokes/min. Easy days: easy conversation. Moderate days: broken conversation. Zero foot impact — ideal given Jones fracture history.

exercises.name: Rowing Ergometer — Intervals
exercises.desc: Zone 2: can talk but would rather not. ~65–75% max HR. Three 4-minute intervals beats one long cruise for VAT reduction. Best conditioning format for android fat pattern.
